summary: Verified new MFCC pipeline display feature (mfcc_pipeline, viz, score_breakdown) end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_mfcc_pipeline.py PASSED against public preview URL — POST /api/analyses returns all 3 new fields with correct structure (7 pipeline stages pre_emphasis→dct, DCT sample has exactly 13 values, viz.waveform.sr=22050 with matched min/max arrays ≤400, viz.spectrum.db ≤128, viz.heatmap rows=13/cols≤96, score_breakdown.intonation formula contains σ_pitch, clarity formula contains 0.45/0.40/0.15 weights, scores 0..100 rounded to 1 dp). GET /api/analyses/{id} returns identical fields (Mongo round-trip clean, no BSON serialization issues). Legacy analyses (3 pre-feature docs in siswa history: StorageCheck, TEST Analysis, TEST Audio Playback) still return 200 with mfcc_pipeline/viz/score_breakdown absent — no 500s, no regressions. Guru can read a siswa analysis and receives full pipeline payload. Frontend (Expo web): siswa logs in, opens the pipeline-enabled analysis 2d5ad248-... — all 9 testIDs render: score-breakdown-section, score-breakdown-intonation, score-breakdown-clarity, mfcc-pipeline-section, mfcc-stage-mel_filterbank, mfcc-stage-dct, viz-waveform, viz-spectrum, mfcc-heatmap; scores shown rounded (37, 94) not long floats. Legacy analysis 92d32a26-... renders mfcc-pipeline-legacy-note and does NOT render mfcc-pipeline-section, no crash. Guru login → direct navigation to same result id → all 4 MFCC sections render for guru role as well.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — carried over from previous iterations, not related to new MFCC components.

action_items: None blocking. All requested MFCC pipeline features work as spec.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_mfcc_display recomputes librosa.stft / mel_basis / pyin-independent stages inside the same request as _extract_mfcc_features (which also runs stft internally). This roughly doubles CPU on every upload. Consider passing S_power / log_mel from _extract_mfcc_features into _build_mfcc_display instead of recomputing.

viz.heatmap.values is a 13×96 float matrix (~1248 numbers) plus stage sample arrays are persisted into Mongo on every analysis. Doc size for the demo record is fine (<50KB) but if many uploads occur it will bloat the collection. Consider computing viz on-the-fly in GET /analyses/{id} from raw audio or storing compact int8 quantized heatmap.

score_breakdown.intonation.substitution branch for pitch_std==0 hard-codes 40 but the formula string still shows '|σ − 45| × 1.4'. Slightly misleading — either show the fallback formula in that case or expose a separate 'base_score_when_zero' field.

Legacy detection on the frontend uses `!data.mfcc_pipeline` which will also hide the new sections if a future analysis fails partway through _build_mfcc_display and stores partial data. Consider explicit boolean like `has_pipeline` from backend for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 10 testIDs verified across siswa new, siswa legacy, guru)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MFCC_Pipeline analyses via POST /api/analyses during pytest run (multiple; safe to leave, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_mfcc_pipeline.py runs with `pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_mfcc_pipeline.py` (need to override pytest.ini addopts that force xdist). Frontend result screen has legacy vs new detection via `data.mfcc_pipeline` truthiness — legacy id 92d32a26-8d03-4568-a0ea-c503ab6d8353 confirmed showing 'mfcc-pipeline-legacy-note'. Pipeline-enabled id 2d5ad248-8383-4d41-a578-63ee1f0ca293 renders full sections. Note the intonation-score for pure-tone-ish uploads is ~37 (σ_pitch small) — this is expected per feature spec, not a bug.
